name: Panoptic NeRF
definition: A method specializing in urban environments for 3D-to-2D label propagation, using two semantic fields: one learned by a semantic head and another determined by 3D bounding boxes.
summary: Panoptic NeRF is a 3D-to-2D label propagation method for urban environments that uses a dual semantic field architecture to enforce geometric correctness and capture semantic distribution.
